replies.author: Zintenka
replies.body:
It is much preferred if you use default textures with no shaders. It makes your map look cool but in reality it might not be good-looking. 

Please use no shaders.

From what i see the map is small. It doesnt look like a swamp at all.

Lengthen the map a bit more and give it a swampy feel.

replies.author: herobrinedude32
Matic0B
replies.body:
I feel the map might be a bit small but still seems very nice. The only thing I suggest is add a little bit more water and possibly trees that you can climb to get on a higher point.

I am liking the custom trees but that dark oak tree doesn't really fit IMO. Replace that with a nice custom tree and it will be much better.

I also suggest doing some broken down temples or just broken buildings in general as it would just spice the map up a bit more.

Overall pretty nice looking map. Has a lot of potential and I feel good things will come from this.

Just get a DL and YML and you are good to go!
